mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.3% signals sustained monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.3% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% indicates labor market slack that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0%, or correlation between UNRATE > 9.0% and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in > 55% of cases, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0% in a supply contraction regime indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0% fails to predict negative returns in > 50% of cases, or correlation between INDPRO < 95.0% and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 11300.0 (Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 11300.0 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 210.0 indicates persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 210.0 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in > 55% of cases, or correlation between CPIAUCSL > 210.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 131000.0) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.3%) signals robust labor market conditions and accommodative monetary policy that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength and monetary easing
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS > 131000.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.3% fails to produce positive returns in > 55% of cases, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0%), labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: High unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0%) fails to predict negative returns in > 50% of cases, or correlation between UNRATE > 9.0% and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
